verdictEs: Thunderstore es la primary platform de Valheim hoy — 10,000+ paquetes con dependency resolution automática y soporte nativo en los managers. Nexus es secondary, útil para texture packs y mods históricos que no migraron al ecosistema principal.
verdictEn: Thunderstore is Valheim's primary platform today — 10,000+ packages with automatic dependency resolution and native manager support. Nexus is secondary, useful for texture packs and historical mods that didn't migrate to the main ecosystem.

useCases.labelEs: Instalar una modlist de QoL + gameplay nueva
useCases.labelEn: Installing a fresh QoL + gameplay modlist
useCases.reasonEs: Casi todos los mods nuevos publican en Thunderstore primero. r2modman/Gale/TMM consumen Thunderstore directamente — un click instala el mod y sus dependencies.
useCases.reasonEn: Almost all new mods publish to Thunderstore first. r2modman/Gale/TMM consume Thunderstore directly — one click installs the mod and its dependencies.

useCases.labelEs: Conseguir texture packs HD y skins visuales
useCases.labelEn: Getting HD texture packs and visual skins
useCases.reasonEs: Históricamente Nexus aloja la mayoría de texture packs grandes y mods de modelo 3D. Thunderstore tiene algunos pero el catálogo visual de Valheim vive más en Nexus.
useCases.reasonEn: Historically Nexus hosts most large texture packs and 3D model mods. Thunderstore has some but Valheim's visual catalog lives more on Nexus.

useCases.reasonEs: Thunderstore es free tier ilimitado sin rate limits ni paywalls. Nexus free tier limita speed y obliga a esperar entre downloads.
useCases.reasonEn: Thunderstore is unlimited free tier with no rate limits or paywalls. Nexus free tier caps speed and forces waits between downloads.

useCases.labelEs: Encontrar mods abandonados de 2021-2022 que no migraron
useCases.labelEn: Finding 2021-2022 abandoned mods that didn't migrate
useCases.reasonEs: Nexus conserva mods que sus autores nunca subieron a Thunderstore. Para arqueología de modlists viejas, Nexus es la referencia.
useCases.reasonEn: Nexus keeps mods their authors never uploaded to Thunderstore. For archeology of old modlists, Nexus is the reference.

useCases.reasonEs: Los tres managers principales hablan Thunderstore nativo. Nexus requiere Vortex como manager separado, con onboarding distinto.
useCases.reasonEn: The three main managers speak Thunderstore natively. Nexus requires Vortex as a separate manager with a different onboarding.
